meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询癌症依赖图谱数据，发现肿瘤靶点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在癌症研究中使用DepMap数据筛选基因依赖或药物敏感性。
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer dependency map data to discover tumor targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze cancer gene dependencies or drug sensitivity data from DepMap.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能查询 DepMap 数据库，获取某基因在各癌细胞系中的依赖分数，比较不同癌种差异，还能结合突变数据找合成致死搭档，辅助药物靶点筛选。
howto.when: 当用户要求查询某个基因在癌细胞中的必需性、比较不同癌种间的依赖差异，或寻找与特定突变相关的合成致死搭档时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下 KRAS 基因在肺癌细胞系里的依赖分数
say.note: Claude 会展示各肺癌细胞系的 KRAS 依赖分数。

say.text: 看看 BRCA1 突变细胞系里哪些基因变得更必需
找一找与 MYC 依赖分数相关性最高的基因
say.note: Claude 会计算共必需性，列出与 MYC 最相关的基因。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query the DepMap database to retrieve CRISPR dependency scores for a gene across cancer cell lines, compare differences between cancer types, and combine mutation data to find synthetic lethal partners, helping to prioritize drug targets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about a gene's essentiality in cancer cells, compares dependency across cancer types, or looks for synthetic lethal partners associated with a specific mutation.

say_en.text: Check the dependency scores of KRAS in lung cancer cell lines.
say_en.note: Claude will show KRAS dependency scores across lung lines.

say_en.text: Find genes that become more essential in BRCA1-mutant cell lines.
Find genes most correlated with MYC dependency.
say_en.note: Claude computes co-essentiality and lists top correlated genes.
